description: This PHP class defines financial calculation functions related to interest, specifically for cash flow analysis in investment scenarios. It includes methods for calculating interest payments, schedule payments, and interest rates, with validation and error handling.

classes.name: Interest
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate various interest-related financial metrics such as interest payment, schedule payment, and rate, with input validation and error handling.

methods.name: payment
methods.description: Calculates the interest payment for a specific period of an investment based on periodic, constant payments and interest rate.

methods.name: schedulePayment
methods.description: Calculates the interest payment for a specified period in a loan amortization schedule.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Computes the interest rate per period of an annuity using an iterative numerical method.
